rules.retained_obligations: Reload -> start -> explicit mode -> COMMITTING mapping audit; DB-backed modes require blocking DB-backed hooks.
rules.boundary: Sequence belongs to the profile; canonical authority and refusal on unavailable backend remain engine invariants.

rules.retained_obligations: THINKING, EXPLORING, COMMITTING retain current permissions and retained-exploration conversion.
rules.boundary: Mode is distinct from delivery lane and native assurance. No relaxation of native write admission.

rules.retained_obligations: COMMITTING has one traceable owner; session work is integration/handoff/orchestration unless an explicit exception exists.
rules.boundary: Current session/cycle handlers retain these preconditions; sessions/cycles are not made universal workflow primitives.

rules.retained_obligations: Core DoR: ownership, objective, scope/non-scope, first step, constraints and required usage_matrix; adaptive depth by cycle type.
rules.boundary: Mandatory core remains invariant. Only adaptive depth and configured thresholds belong to project policy; existing adapter remains canonical.

rules.retained_obligations: Mandatory drift-check on suspicion; findings, recovery choices and explicit change handling before continuation.
rules.boundary: No automated inference of human suspicion or acceptance; existing drift gates remain authoritative.

rules.retained_obligations: Select R1/R2/R3 before creating a branch; R2 needs predecessor import; R3 needs rationale and accepted risk; mismatch stops for user choice.
rules.boundary: Explicit intent and coherent ownership are engine invariants; continuity strategy belongs to the profile.

rules.retained_obligations: Drift check and explicit per-open-cycle resolution, close notes/snapshots, review-ready PR handoff; mandatory DB constraint chain in dual/db-only.
rules.boundary: Missing/stale canonical context refuses; resolved outcome and nested checkpoint success stay distinct from admission.

rules.retained_obligations: Push/open-or-recover/triage/merge; valid threads fixed and tested, invalid threads explained; unresolved threads require explicit documented rationale.
rules.boundary: PR routing is tested; actual review and merge authority remain human/provider evidence.

rules.retained_obligations: After merge identify branch, fetch source, compare divergence; reconcile before new session/cycle; ambiguous strategy requires human choice.
rules.boundary: Git continuity is enforced by existing handlers; shadow data authorizes no fetch, merge or reconciliation.

rules.retained_obligations: Incident triage L1-L4; L1 local repair, L2 tracked repair, L3/L4 STOP and authorization before rule edits; resume checkpoint and retain concise history.
rules.boundary: Project-specific triggers may live in the adapter; severity stop/authorization obligations cannot be weakened.

rules.retained_obligations: Reload required; COMMITTING audit required; skills do not decide or duplicate rules; missing audit state stops; shared-risk validation must converge across usages.
rules.boundary: Definition is reference_data, never a second normative authority. Promotion stays DONE-only and all existing obligations remain.

evidence.expected_proof: Record context-reload then start-session, explicit mode and COMMITTING branch audit; hooks alone do not prove the human sequence.
Actions, reason codes, mapped identities and explicit choices match the existing source-branch helper.
Ambiguous/missing mappings refuse; multiple candidates require selection; explicit focus chooses the matching cycle.
THINKING does not implement, EXPLORING retained work enters a cycle, COMMITTING retains ownership. Warning behavior is covered separately by mapped_choices.
Existing CLI fixtures admit unique owners and refuse missing mapping; complete_cycle_warning_propagates retains nested warnings.
Source requires explicit choice; session R2 and latest-cycle R1 pass; canonical unavailable/ambiguous context refuses.
Existing COMMITTING admission keeps canonical objective, scope, first step, constraints and project-adapter DoR checks.
Suspected drift invokes drift-check; confirmed drift records recovery and parking-lot/CR/cycle/scope decision before resuming.
L1 can self-repair; L2 retains temporary evidence; L3/L4 stop and require human authorization before changing rules.
Validate declared usage_matrix with meaningful non-primary usage; one passing nominal case cannot establish shared-surface stability.
Terminal cycle closure keeps canonical evidence and propagates nested warning/refusal; terminal checkpoint does not reactivate a cycle.
Only retained DONE cycles may be promoted; non-retained outcomes keep history and cannot enter the session baseline.
Missing session, unresolved/stale cycles and stale report refuse; resolved close retains decisions and outside-session warning.
Existing CLI fixtures distinguish push, open PR, await review, post-merge sync and canonical lifecycle refusals.
Triage valid/invalid Codex threads with evidence and resolve or record explicit rationale before merge; await_review is not proof of human review.
Merged with pending sync refuses a new session; reconciled merge permits it.
Block overrides clean; warning routes audit-first; unknown reanchors; clear permits execution-or-audit.
files/dual/db-only honor configured PostgreSQL, reject unavailable authority and stale/misleading projections; SQLite canonical reads preserve storage.
Same schema expresses diagnosis, human approval, correction, review and at most two review-to-correction returns, then stop. No compiler/executor is claimed.
